name: Wildwood Golf Course
architects: Bill O'Meara (built by the O'Meara family on the site of a closed nine-hole course; first nine opened 1991)

dtm.source: DOGAMI lidar DIGITAL_TERRAIN_MODEL_MOSAIC (bare earth), exportImage at 1 m in EPSG:32610, box x 508813-510037 / y 5057547-5059027, downloaded by the developer 2026-10-24 (GitHub release wildwood-data, exportImage.15.tiff)

chm.source: DOGAMI lidar CANOPY_HEIGHT_MODEL_MOSAIC (highest hit minus bare earth), exportImage at 1 m in EPSG:32610, same box, downloaded by the developer 2026-10-24 (GitHub release wildwood-data, exportImage.14.tiff)
chm.label: DOGAMI canopy height model

ortho.source: Oregon Statewide Imagery Program 2024 (0.5 m), exportImage JPEG from imagery.oregonexplorer.info OSIP_2024_WM, placed by its request bbox (make_ortho.py; GitHub release wildwood-data, exportImage.jpg)

world.note: OSM course boundary bbox (774 x 838 m, way 428675780) + at least 120 m of scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred (125 m west/east, 221 m south/north)

scorecard_source: Club scorecard image (Wildwood-Scorecard-for-Website.webp, GitHub release wildwood-data, uploaded by the developer 2026-10-24), read 2026-10-24. Every row adds up to the printed Out/In/Total; handicaps 1-18 once each. Ratings/slopes (men/ladies): Black 69.1/127, 74.5/134; White 67.9/124, 73.3/133; Orange 64.5/113, 69.6/125. GolfPass lists 68.9/124 for one unnamed set.
attribution: Elevation and canopy height: Oregon Department of Geology and Mineral Industries (DOGAMI) lidar
Scorecard and course map: Wildwood Golf Course
notes: Standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1), 2026-10-24: no Blue on the card, so Black (5,853 yd, the set closest to 6,300); all water red; OB = the OSM course boundary, roads inside it are cart paths, the driving range is OB; pnw theme; inland Pacific Northwest wind 1-7 mph; trees from DOGAMI lidar, trees in fairways or in the way of a centre-line drive removed and listed.

remove_wires.note: the canopy model holds a utility line along US 30 east of the course (a dotted line of single cells); s05 removes wires before finding trees

trees_need_ortho.note: the DOGAMI lidar is older than the OSIP 2024 photo: trees since removed (e.g. down the 9th fairway) are still in the canopy model; lidar crowns that are not dark canopy on the photo are dropped (pipeline/gorse.py missing_in_ortho)

drop_trees.reason: hole 2: a 24 m crown 16 m in front of the Black tee; a perfect drive at the middle of the fairway clips it 21 m out (game tee-shot test; standing default, COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1). s06b's own check passed it

hole 7: a 46 m fir at the right edge of the fairway whose 12.6 m crown overhangs the OSM line of play 58 m from the Black tee; the game's default aim (down the line) drives into it and stops in the woods (game test). Standing default: trees in a perfect tee-shot line are removed

red_water_note: w825464987: the creek strip between the 2nd green and the 5th tee; w676379150: the swimming pool behind the house north of the 16th tee, a red penalty area at the developer's request (2026-10-24: 'that would be funny'); pools inside the boundary otherwise paint as rough
